subtasks: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
Place the largest doll held in the right gripper upright at the far right end of the row, directly below its current position. Leave room for the second-largest doll between it and the middle doll.

Pick up the second-largest nesting doll at the far right beside the hairbrush. Place it upright in the open fourth position, halfway between the middle doll and the largest doll, aligned with the other dolls.
Withdraw the open right gripper upward clear of the upright dolls, then return both fully open grippers to their initial poses and leave the row undisturbed.
